title: Create Chaos (Season 2)
description: This is the modpack for Create Chaos 2, have fun!
body:
This modpack transforms Minecraft into a fully immersive and mechanically rich experience. With a heavy focus on the Create mod and its expansions, you can build intricate contraptions, automated factories, and transport systems while enjoying enhanced visuals, 3D models, and dynamic player interactions.

Key Features:

Create Ecosystem: Full support for Create, Create Additions, Create Deco, Create Ore Excavation, Create Jetpacks, and more, giving limitless automation and building possibilities.

Player Immersion: 3D Armor, 3D Hands, Skins 3D, Sit & Hat commands, Voice Chat, and sophisticated animations make your character feel alive.

Visual Enhancements: Better Clouds, Better Grassify, Iris Shaders support, Ambient & Drip Sounds, Picture Mode, and Dynamic Crosshair.

Gameplay Quality of Life: JEI, AppleSkin, Controlling, Clumps, Searchables, Inventory Profiles Next, Better Advancements, and Accurate Block Placement streamline building and inventory management.

Exploration & Adventure: Antique Atlas, Custom Nether Portals, Dragonkind, Dragonfight, Ender Dragon Fight Remastered, and Create: Let The Adventure Begin expand your world and combat challenges.

Customization & Fun: Accessories, Emotes, Chat Heads, Emoji Type, Create: Food & Bitterballen, and many aesthetic mods enhance personalization.

Performance & Stability: Sodium, Lithium, Ferrite Core, BadOptimizations, Spark, and Crash Assistant ensure smooth gameplay on large, complex builds.

Perfect for players who love engineering, automation, creativity, and immersive roleplay, this modpack blends technical depth with quality-of-life enhancements, giving you the ultimate sandbox experience.
